title: Six project tools for a 12-person agency that bills by the hour
variant: Wide grid: options as columns, many attributes in bands
prompt: Compare six project management tools for a 12-person creative agency that bills hourly.
note: Tools run as columns and thirteen attributes as rows in four bands, because six options across a wide table is the shape a reader knows from review-site spec tables and the bands let the eye find the one band (Billing hourly) that decides this brief. The page stays light and airy with a sans title and wide margins, the legend explains each band in a clause above the table, and the only chrome is the matrix card itself; the tones do the work and no best mark is used, because with six columns the reader counts green cells rather than stars.
